content: Blocking subprocess.run inside an async FastAPI endpoint or async background task blocks the whole event loop (all concurrent requests stall). Mitigations: declare the endpoint as sync def (FastAPI/Starlette runs it in a threadpool), or wrap with asyncio.to_thread / run_in_threadpool. On Windows Python 3.8+ the default asyncio loop is ProactorEventLoop which DOES support subprocesses; SelectorEventLoop does NOT (subprocess_exec raises NotImplementedError). Uvicorn on Windows forces SelectorEventLoop under --reload or --workers>1, which breaks asyncio subprocess spawning - so run one worker, reload=False, and prefer to_thread(Popen-based) helpers for child-process management.
